en: Photography cooperation: Mr. NAOKI
Don't miss the example battle of the white aircraft from "HOBBY HOBBY Imaging Builders"! White Lightning Z is here! !
Gundam Build Fighters Try official website web project
Appearing in "HOBBY HOBBY Imaging Builders" (http://gundam-bf.net/hhib/) ♪
From ``HOBBY HOBBY Imaging Builders'' comes the white Lightning ZGundam, which has a distinctive white coloring and shoulder marks.
Commercialized as HGBF series.
Reproduce the characteristic colors and markings! !
● Impressive coloring based on white, purple, and yellow!
● Comes with a seal that reproduces the characteristic markings on the shoulders and seals! !
Improve details with water transfer decals and Tetron Seals, which are popular among painting users!
● Stylish form based on ZGundam!
An action gimmick with full play value unique to the Build Fighters series!
Canon form can be reproduced by expanding the binder. Phoenix burst firing form can be reproduced by attaching effect parts.
Attached weapon: Beam rifle
